This 2017 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT combines capability and comfort in a dependable work truck. Powered by a 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 engine with 6-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, this truck delivers the performance you need for any job. With over 117,000 miles and a silver exterior, this Silverado has proven itself a reliable workhorse.

Key Features:
- Heated front cloth bucket seats with cushions and seat backs
- Integrated trailer brake controller for confident towing
- Engine block heater for cold-weather reliability
- LED cargo box lighting for nighttime visibility
- All-Terrain P265/65R18 white-outlined tires
- OnStar 4G LTE connectivity with 3-month Guidance Plan
- Chevrolet MyLink 8" touchscreen with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Bluetooth phone connectivity and steering wheel audio controls

The 18-inch bright machined aluminum wheels complement the truck's rugged appearance while the body-color bumpers and heated power-adjustable mirrors round out the exterior.

This Silverado achieves 16 mpg city and 22 mpg highway, making it efficient for a full-size truck. The All Star Edition package and Off-Road Suspension Package provide added value and capability. Whether you're hauling cargo or tackling challenging terrain, this truck is ready for the road ahead.

description: CAPABLE, WELL-MAINTAINED, NO-ACCIDENT, NONSMOKER, TIMELESS LUXURY AWAITS! The 2011 Range Rover Supercharged continues to prove why this generation remains a benchmark for full-size luxury SUV capability, pairing genuine V8 Supercharged power with the commanding presence and go-anywhere confidence that's defined the Range Rover nameplate for decades. With a documented history of 18 service records, this example shows the kind of consistent care that keeps a vehicle like this running strong well past six figures on the odometer. 4WD is central to what makes a Range Rover a Range Rover. Land Rover's Terrain Response system lets the driver tailor the four-wheel-drive system's behavior to the surface underneath -- mud, sand, rock, or snow -- giving this Range Rover genuine off-road credibility that few luxury SUVs from this era, or even today, can match. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL This generation of Range Rover earned its reputation by refusing to choose between genuine off-road capability and true luxury-flagship comfort, a formula few rivals have ever successfully matched. Buyers consistently point to its commanding driving position, a beautifully finished cabin, and a Supercharged V8 that delivers effortless power regardless of terrain or conditions. That combination of capability and prestige has kept the Range Rover in a class of its own among full-size luxury SUVs, and well-maintained examples like this one continue to hold genuine appeal for buyers who want the real thing rather than a crossover playing dress-up. WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 133,509-mile mark, and the original factory warranty has expired. At roughly 8,600 miles per year on average since new, this Range Rover has actually been driven at a notably light pace for its age, and a CARFAX history showing 18 service records suggests it's been consistently maintained rather than neglected. Extended service plans may be available to help provide additional peace of mind moving forward. STANDARD FEATURES Supercharged trim sat at the top of the Range Rover lineup for this generation, and the equipment visible on this example reflects that positioning -- heated and cooled front seats, Windsor leather seating surfaces, and a genuinely well-appointed cabin throughout. A navigation system and rear-seat entertainment screens are also present, adding real convenience beyond what a standard-trim Range Rover of this era would offer. MECHANICAL FEATURES Power comes from Land Rover's 5.0-liter supercharged V8 -- confirmed directly under the hood -- paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission featuring CommandShift manual control. This combination delivers genuinely effortless power on the road while retaining the low-range gearing and Terrain Response system that make this Range Rover a legitimate off-road performer, not just a badge. Properly equipped, this generation of Supercharged Range Rover is rated to tow up to roughly 7,700 pounds, giving it real capability for a boat, camper, or utility trailer well beyond typical luxury SUV expectations. EXTERIOR FEATURES Finished in Stornoway Gray, this Range Rover wears its commanding, unmistakable silhouette well -- a design that's aged remarkably gracefully compared to many SUVs from the same era. The two-tone alloy wheels visible on this example add a genuinely upscale finishing touch to the Range Rover's already imposing stance. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, black leather seating trims out a genuinely handsome cabin, with heated and cooled front seats adding real comfort regardless of season. Rear-seat entertainment screens mounted in the front headrests give back-seat passengers their own dedicated viewing, a thoughtful touch for longer family trips. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY A touchscreen navigation system anchors the dashboard, while a Harman/Kardon sound system with satellite radio capability rounds out a genuinely premium audio experience for a vehicle of this era. SAFETY FEATURES Land Rover's Terrain Response system and full-time four-wheel drive provide confident, predictable handling across a wide range of surfaces and conditions, backed by the era-appropriate stability and traction control systems Land Rover equipped this generation with. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! THE BOTTOM LINE This Range Rover pairs everything that's made this generation a genuine luxury SUV icon -- true V8 Supercharged power, real off-road hardware, and a beautifully finished cabin -- with a well-documented maintenance history and notably light annual mileage for its age. For a buyer who wants the genuine article rather than a modern crossover pretending to be one, this is exactly that. Fifteen years in, this Range Rover still looks like it has somewhere important to be.
